conclusion: Historical data cannot identify the cause. New collection/phase/CPU and parent-process clocks expose future gaps; timeouts bound test/process waits.

additional_observation.interpretation: Execution/suspend-like gap localized to a pure backtest phase; no evidence of lifecycle teardown blocking; exact OS/host cause unproven.

deadline_fix: Windows waits can exclude low-power intervals. Explicit perf-counter post-resume/post-completion checks and phase checks reject over-budget success; regression tests cover both.
